data.name: Mahroosh
data.gender_notes: Mahroosh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is gracious, kind, and pleasing. The name Mahroosh carries the meaning “Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mahroosh usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to the spiritual trait of being kind and gracious to others, as well as being pleasing to Allah.
data.etymology: Mahroosh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahroosh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مهرוש
in_arabic.meaning: مهروش تعني الشخص الذي يحب ويعطي الكثير من الحب
in_arabic.long_meaning: مهروش هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'مهر' الذي يعني الحب والعطاء. يعني الاسم الشخص الذي يحب ويعطي الكثير من الحب والمودة. في اللغة العربية، 'مهر' هو الفعل الذي يعني 'أعطى' أو 'وهب'. الاسم مهروش هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرتبطة بالعطاء والحب في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: مہروش
in_urdu.meaning: مہروش کا مطلب ہے جو شخص بہت زیادہ محبت کرتا ہے اور دیتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہروش ایک عربی मूल کا اسم علم ہے، جو 'مهر' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے محبت اور عطا کرنا۔ یہ نام اس شخص کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو بہت زیادہ محبت کرتا ہے اور دیتا ہے۔ اردو میں، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلم معاشرے میں محبت اور عطا کے اسلامی اقدار سے وابستہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: महरोश
in_hindi.meaning: महरोश का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति बहुत अधिक प्रेम करता है और देता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: महरोश एक अरबी मूल का नाम है, जो 'महर' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है प्रेम और देना। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति को संबोधित करता है जो बहुत अधिक प्रेम करता है और देता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम प्रेम और उदारता के मूल्यों से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: مهروش
in_pashto.meaning: مهروش دى هغه چا چې ډېر مینه کوي او ډیر څه ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهروش د عربي اصل يو نوم دی، چې د 'مهر' د فعل څخه اخستل شوی دی، چي د مینې او ورکړې معنی لري. دا نوم هغه چا ته خطاب کوي چي ډېر مینه کوي او ډیر څه ورکوي. په پښتني کلتور کې، دا نوم د مینې او سخاوت د ارزښتونو سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Mahroosh
in_english.meaning: Mahroosh means one who loves and gives much
in_english.long_meaning: Mahroosh is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'mahr' which means to love and to give. The name signifies one who loves and gives much, embodying the values of generosity and affection. Etymologically, it relates to the Arabic root 'm-h-r' which conveys the sense of giving and loving. Historically, names with such roots have been used in Islamic tradition to reflect positive attributes and spiritual qualities. The name Mahroosh is associated with kindness, compassion, and generosity, making it a meaningful choice for parents seeking a name with deep spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahroosh carries a profound sense of elegance and grace in Islamic culture. It is a name that evokes feelings of kindness, mercy, and compassion. In various Islamic literatures, a Mahroosh character is often depicted as a noble figure who is beloved by all for their charitable nature, generosity, and pleasant disposition. The cultural significance of the name Mahroosh lies in its reminder of the importance of being gracious and kind to others, reflecting the core spiritual values of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mahroosh carries deep spiritual significance, especially within the Islamic context. It is derived from the Arabic words 'Maroo' (to be satisfied, contented, or pleased) and 'Rush' (grace or gratitude). Thus, Mahroosh symbolizes the inner disposition of someone who is content with Allah (SWT)'s will and is gracious towards others. In Islamic spirituality, a Mahroosh person is considered to be blessed, for their hearts are filled with the remembrance of Allah and their actions are guided by Allah's mercy and kindness towards all beings. Consequently, the spiritual significance of the name Mahroosh lies in its reminder of the importance of inner contentment and gratitude towards Allah, as well as the significance of extending Allah's mercy and kindness towards others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gracious" symbolizes One who is gracious, kind, and pleasing.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mahroosh serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gracious.
